summary:
Updated implementation plan for Bharatiyam Panchanga — Flutter app with Android APK + Web preview.

Key changes from v1:
- Technology: Flutter (not Vite+JS) — builds Android APK + web via GitHub Actions
- Pournimanta: Full calculation with Purnima-to-Purnima boundary detection
- Lagna: Full 12-rashi rising/setting times for day and night
- Night muhurtas: All 15 included
- Location: GPS auto-detect + city selector with 500+ Indian cities
- Date range: 1900–2100
- Export: PDF + image (screenshot) export
- Swiss Ephemeris via sweph Dart package (same as reference app)
- Lahiri Ayanamsha, mid-limb sunrise
- 7 languages: Kannada, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam, English, Sanskrit
- GitHub Actions CI/CD for build
- All panchanga features from reference app plus new additions
- 5 implementation phases with detailed file structure
